_comment: What each dashboard section's chart actually renders — DASHBOARD_SPEC.md §15.5. Declared, not inferred from labels: the first audit threw a false positive purely from string-matching a cut name against a section name. Verified against the consolidated CSV by guards/validate_card_cuts.py, so a drift between this and buildSections() fails a gate rather than silently mis-charting a card.
_labels_note: `labels` is declared only where rbi_sibc.ts uses a fixed code->label map instead of the CSV sector name (bankCredit, mainSectors). Every other section takes the CSV name plus rbi_sibc_label_overrides.json. Codes are NOT unique across statements — 2.3 is 'Large' in Statement 1 and 'Beverage and Tobacco' in Statement 2 — so a label lookup must always be scoped by statement.
